So my partner and I have been together six years and lately we barely talk except about logistics — bills, whose turn it is to cook, the dog. We used to stay up until 2am just talking. I don't think either of us is unhappy exactly, but I miss being curious about each other and I can't tell if this is just what long relationships become or if we're drifting somewhere neither of us wants to go. I'm not asking whether to leave; I'm asking how to bring back some of what we had, or whether I need to accept that this is the shape of things now.

I've started and abandoned four different creative projects this year (a novel, a podcast, a small app, a garden). Each time I'm genuinely excited for two or three weeks, then something shifts and I can't make myself go back to it. I don't think it's laziness — I work hard at my job — and it doesn't feel like fear of failure either, more like the thing stops mattering. I'd like to understand the pattern rather than just push harder.
